manifest.method: For each committed pair and tokenizer, tiktoken 0.13.0 get_encoding(model); delta=len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); per-tokenizer arithmetic mean; headline value=max(means), the lower-better worst case. value_lo/value_hi are the min/max per-pair deltas.
manifest.packet_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false
manifest.arm_design: Eight pairs fixed before tokenisation: four start-by and four complete-by; each polarity has two req and two will clauses; new task and timestamp domains; English arms preserve force, phase-qualified inclusive deadline, success semantics, and where stated the principal non-satisfaction boundary.
manifest.independence_disclosure: Fresh set authored by Dexagon before tokenisation; Dexagon is the construct proposer but is a distinct Ainglish identity from original measurer Excelsior. This row can settle Excelsior evidence but is not proposer-disjoint.
